case_identification.title: Project ReFlow: Digital Supply Chain Transformation

problem_diagnosis.core_bottleneck: Manual picking travel in 3 DCs and unoptimized transport routes causing 8.5% late delivery rate, $86.4M logistics cost ($7.20/order), and 18,000 tonnes CO2e.
root_causes: Intra-DC manual search and picking causing 38% cycle time drag and 2.4% error rate.
Fragmented LTL transport routing and dead-head miles creating low vehicle fill (62%).
High diesel consumption generating 18,000 tonnes of logistics greenhouse gas emissions.

approved_solution.name: Portfolio A+B: Warehouse Automation & Transport Optimization
approved_solution.value_proposition: CAD $13.0M deployment cuts late deliveries from 8.5% to 3.5%, eliminates 4,500 tonnes CO2e (-25%), and yields CAD $8.08M net savings/yr with +$7.094M 3-year NPV.

pillars.impact: $4.9M Net Savings | -2.0 pt Late Rate | -8% CO2

pillars.name: Intelligent Transport ML (Option B)
pillars.impact: $3.9M Net Savings | -3.2 pt Late Rate | -18% CO2

pillars.name: CAD $7.0M Capital Buffer Retained
pillars.impact: Leaves 35% of authorized $20M budget as risk reserve

red_team_defense.question: Why is your portfolio better than Portfolio B+C, which has higher gross savings?
red_team_defense.rebuttal: Portfolio B+C requires $17.0M capex ($4.0M more than A+B) and carries $2.2M OpEx on C, crushing its 3-year NPV to $3.44M vs $7.09M for A+B. A+B generates double the net economic value at lower operational risk.

red_team_defense.question: What happens if implementation capex escalates by 25%?
red_team_defense.rebuttal: At $16.25M, the budget remains safely below the board's $20.0M ceiling with $3.75M in cash buffer. Simple payback only increases to 24.1 months, and 3-year NPV remains strongly positive at +$3.84 Million.

red_team_defense.question: What if annual net savings fall 30% below forecast?
red_team_defense.rebuttal: At $5.66M net savings/yr, payback is 27.6 months (paying back within the 3-year window), while late delivery drops to 3.5% and carbon emissions drop 25%, fully meeting all board mandates.

red_team_defense.question: How would your strategy adapt if annual order volume increases by 40%?
red_team_defense.rebuttal: Robotic automation and transport algorithms scale non-linearly with zero added labor, lowering cost per order below $5.90 and expanding annual net savings to $11.3M/yr with 3-year NPV exceeding +$15.0M.

red_team_defense.question: Why should NorthStar trust AI-driven algorithms with mission-critical supply chain operations?
red_team_defense.rebuttal: We implement a Human-in-the-Loop model with deterministic fallback dispatch rules and certified collaborative cobots assisting trained operators.
